meta.description: Naturalness ratings of Czech negative polar questions on a seven-point scale from 75 native speakers: a main experiment crossing verb position, indefinite and context, and subexperiments on the particles *náhodou* and *copak*. The paper reports the fixed effects of cumulative link mixed models with random intercepts for items and participants.

types.name: Model
types.doc: The fitted models, one for each verb position of the main experiment and one for each particle.
